retryPolicy.build: Reuse completed content-addressed image only after source labels and digest match
retryPolicy.gitPush: Compare actual remote branch/tag first, then push existing commits; never force push
retryPolicy.deployment: Compare live deployment and Ready pod imageID with intended digest before applying; do not blindly repeat a rollout
retryPolicy.controlCommands: Inspect persisted commandId and outcome; never generate a new ID merely because a response was lost
retryPolicy.backup: Reuse the immutable remote path and verify chunks, whole SHA and SQLite; .part is not a successful backup
retryPolicy.media: Inspect existing verification and preserve valid outputs; use a new directory for incomplete reruns

constraints: Do not change T0, freezeAt or deadlineAt
